disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the Board of Examiners in Optometry shall have the power to revoke or suspend any certificate granted by it pursuant to the provisions of this chapter, for fraud

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional and unethical conduct as defined by the Board
Impairment due to alcohol or narcotic substances
Violation of any rule or regulation promulgated by the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any violation of any rule or regulation promulgated by the Board pursuant to the provisions of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing persons to solicit house-to-house sale of optometric services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employment by an Oklahoma-licensed optometrist of any person to solicit from house to house the sale of lenses, frames, spectacles, or optometric services or examinations

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing fraudulent, deceitful, or misleading advertising of optometric services or prices
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Publishing or displaying, or knowingly causing or permitting to be published or displayed by newspaper, radio, television, window display, poster, sign, billboard, or any other advertising media any statement or advertisement of any price or fee offered or charged by an optometrist for any optometric services or materials including lenses, frames, eyeglasses, or spectacles or parts thereof, including statements or advertisements of discount, premium, or gifts, if the statements or advertisements are fraudulent, deceitful, misleading

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing optometry under any name other than the licensee's proper name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing optometry under any name other than the proper name of the person, which shall be the same name as used in the license issued by the Board to the person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing or administering opioid drugs in excess of statutory maximum limits
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing or administering opioid drugs in excess of the maximum limits authorized in Section 2-309I of Title 63 of the Oklahoma Statutes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Out-of-state license revoked for grounds similar to Oklahoma grounds
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If an out-of-state license or certificate of an optometrist who also holds an Oklahoma license or certificate is suspended or revoked for any reason, the optometrist's Oklahoma license may come under review by the Board.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A licensed optometrist may establish a practice in not more than two office locations in accordance with rules and regulations established by the Board of Examiners in Optometry. Each office shall be registered by the Board and shall maintain such equipment and personnel as required by the Board.

definition_quote.value: The practice of optometry is defined to be the science and art of examining the human eye and measurement of the powers of vision by the employment of any means, including the use or furnishing of any self-testing device, the use of any computerized or automatic refracting device, including applications designed to be used on a computer or video conferencing via an Internet device either in person or in remote locations, the use of pharmaceutical agents, the diagnosis of conditions of the human eye, and the correcting and relief of ocular abnormalities by means including but not limited to prescribing and adaptation of lenses, contact lenses, spectacles, eyeglasses, prisms and the employment of vision therapy or orthoptics for the aid thereof, low vision rehabilitation, laser surgery procedures, excluding retina, laser in-situ keratomileusis (LASIK), and cosmetic lid surgery.
